scientific_limitations: Applies only to nondegenerate Euclidean simplices under normalized Euclidean volume and the full logarithmic Hilbert cross-ratio.
Unique Euclidean-volume maximizing center assumes every fixed finite radius is positive.
Logistic sample-range and Gumbel extreme-value tools are standard and not independently claimed original.
Historical priority remains uncertain because an equivalent result could appear in older Hilbert-geometry or statistics literature.
title: Exact uniform Hilbert geometry of simplices: central balls, median rigidity, and distinct extreme-value limits
